mapper.select: SELECT mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE, mfmp.FACTORY_CODE, mpi.PRODUCT_DESC, mpi.PRO_SIZE, mpi.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, mpi.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME, mpi.SPECIFICATIONS, mpi.PATTERN, mpi.BRAND, mpi.HIERARCHY, mpi.COMMON_TYPE FROM t_mdm_factory_matching_production mfmp LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_info mpi ON mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE = mpi.PRODUCT_CODE AND mfmp.FACTORY_CODE = mpi.FACTORY_CODE WHERE IFNULL(mfmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mfmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mfmp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mfmp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_mp_product_require_plan prp WHERE prp.PRODUCT_CODE = mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = mfmp.FACTORY_CODE AND IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT DISTINCT mfmp.FACTORY_CODE, mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE, mpc.CONSTRUCTION_CODE, mpc.SPEC_CODE, mpc.EMBRYO_CODE, mpc.MOULD_METHOD, mpc.CURING_TIME, mpc.CURING_TIME2, mpc.MOLD_CAVITY, mpc.MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE FROM t_mdm_factory_matching_production mfmp LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_construction mpc ON mpc.FACTORY_CODE = mfmp.FACTORY_CODE AND mpc.PRODUCT_CODE = mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(mpc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(mfmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mfmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mfmp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mfmp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_mp_product_require_plan prp WHERE prp.PRODUCT_CODE = mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = mfmp.FACTORY_CODE AND IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT DISTINCT mdmp.FACTORY_CODE, mdmp.YEAR, mdmp.MONTH, mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AS MOULD_CODE, mdmp.BEGIN_DATE, mdmp.END_DAY, mmi.MOULD_NO, mmi.MOULD_AIR_TYPE FROM t_mdm_device_maintenance_plan mdmp INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_factory_matching_production mfmp ON mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE = pmr.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(mfmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mfmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mfmp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mfmp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} WHERE IFNULL(mdmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mdmp.MACHINE_TYPE = 2 AND mdmp.PLAN_TYPE = 0 AND mdmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mdmp.BEGIN_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND mdmp.END_DAY <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_mp_product_require_plan prp WHERE prp.PRODUCT_CODE = mfmp.PRODUCT_CODE AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = mfmp.FACTORY_CODE AND IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
